points.title: 大学教育
points.description: 哈勃在芝加哥大学完成了他的本科和研究生教育。在这里，他接触到了天文学，并对其产生了浓厚的兴趣。他的导师是著名天文学家乔治·埃里奥特，这对他的学术生涯产生了深远的影响。
points.descriptionEn: Hubble completed his undergraduate and graduate education at the University of Chicago. Here, he was introduced to astronomy and developed a keen interest in the field. His mentor was the renowned astronomer George Ellery Hale, who had a profound impact on his academic career.

points.title: 天文观测与研究
points.description: 哈勃在威尔逊山天文台工作，这里拥有当时世界上最大的望远镜。他利用这台望远镜进行了大量的观测，发现了许多重要的天文现象，包括宇宙膨胀的证据，这一发现彻底改变了我们对宇宙的理解。
points.descriptionEn: Hubble worked at the Mount Wilson Observatory, which housed the world's largest telescope at the time. He conducted extensive observations with this telescope, discovering many important astronomical phenomena, including evidence of the expansion of the universe, which fundamentally changed our understanding of the cosmos.

points.title: 学术生涯
points.description: 哈勃回到芝加哥大学，成为了一名教授。他在这里继续他的研究工作，并培养了一代天文学家。他的工作为天文学的发展做出了巨大贡献。
points.descriptionEn: Hubble returned to the University of Chicago as a professor. He continued his research work here and trained a generation of astronomers. His work made a significant contribution to the development of astronomy.

points.title: 国家科学院
points.description: 哈勃在华盛顿的国家科学院工作，继续他的研究。他在这里的工作对天文学的发展产生了深远的影响，特别是在宇宙学领域。
points.descriptionEn: Hubble worked at the National Academy of Sciences in Washington, D.C., continuing his research. His work here had a profound impact on the development of astronomy, particularly in the field of cosmology.

supporter.zh: 哈勃被誉为现代宇宙学的奠基人之一，他的发现彻底改变了我们对宇宙的理解。他的工作为天文学的发展做出了巨大贡献，被广泛认为是20世纪最伟大的天文学家之一。
supporter.en: Hubble is hailed as one of the founders of modern cosmology, whose discoveries fundamentally changed our understanding of the universe. His work has made a significant contribution to the development of astronomy and is widely regarded as one of the greatest astronomers of the 20th century.

critic.zh: 一些批评者认为，哈勃的工作虽然重要，但也存在局限性。他的观测方法在某些方面可能过于简单，而且他的理论有时过于依赖观测数据。
critic.en: Some critics argue that while Hubble's work was important, it also had limitations. His observational methods may have been overly simplistic in some respects, and his theories sometimes relied too heavily on observational data.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，哈勃被广泛认为是20世纪最重要的天文学家之一。他的工作不仅推动了天文学的发展，也对物理学和宇宙学产生了深远的影响。在大众文化中，他通常被视为一个科学英雄，他的形象被用来象征人类对宇宙的好奇心和探索精神。
objective.en: In the historical community, Hubble is widely regarded as one of the most important astronomers of the 20th century. His work not only advanced the field of astronomy but also had a profound impact on physics and cosmology. In popular culture, he is often portrayed as a scientific hero, symbolizing human curiosity and the spirit of exploration of the universe.

self.zh: 宇宙是如此宏大，以至于我们无法完全理解它。
self.en: The universe is so vast that we cannot fully understand it.

others.zh: 哈勃是20世纪最伟大的科学家之一，他的工作改变了我们对宇宙的认识。
others.en: Hubble is one of the greatest scientists of the 20th century, whose work changed our understanding of the universe.
